step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows a serverless real-time notification engine for IoT water infrastructure alerts. Alerts from IoT platforms/API Gateway are published to SNS. SNS fans out messages to SQS queues, which trigger Lambda functions. Lambda handles routing to multiple destinations: persisting notification history in DynamoDB, sending SMS alerts via external SMS service, delivering email via Amazon SES, and updating the application front-end UI via WebSockets. Amazon RDS stores auxiliary metadata such as subscriber lists and templates.

graph.name: Mueller Water Products Real-time Notification Engine
graph.notes: 100% serverless notification architecture serving over 1 million deployed IoT devices.

nodes.name: SNS

nodes.name: SQS
nodes.notes: Queues incoming notifications per delivery route before invoking Lambda.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Contains business logic for processing and dispatching notifications to different targets.

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: Stores user information, HTML/SMS templates, and subscriber lists.

nodes.notes: Delivers real-time SMS notifications to field technicians.
